overview_description.description:
Gojiberry AI is an AI Agent that finds high intent leads for B2B companies. It learns your ideal customer profile and detects buying signals such as :

- interactions on niche content
- interactions on competitors
- leads that participated to a specific webinar
- leads that just joined a niche group
- companies that just raised funds
- companies that are hiring right now for a specific job.

Finally, it sends you fresh leads with their full contact data, everyday.
